components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid ink, turns red on hover: Open the portfolio, Check.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 22px; border-radius: 2px; font: 650 1.02rem Archivo, sans-serif; color: var(--paper, #F4F4F1); background: var(--ink, #16171A); text-decoration: none; transition: transform .12s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), background-color .2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent, #C8202B); color: var(--on-accent, #fff); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #C8202B); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: 1px ink frame: Dark mode, Reset the riddle.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border-radius: 2px; font: 650 1rem Archivo, sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #16171A); background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--ink, #16171A); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .2s, color .2s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--ink, #16171A); color: var(--paper, #F4F4F1); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #C8202B); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Input
components.css: .ds-input { min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--ink, #16171A); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--paper-deep, #E8E8E4); color: var(--text, #2A2C30); font: 1rem Archivo, sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #C8202B); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Bar
components.description: Name left in the card's lettering, links right, red underline for the current section.
components.html: Shafik AdamExperienceProjectsContact
components.css: .ds-bar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 0 16px; height: 64px; background: var(--paper, #F4F4F1); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ink, #16171A); font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; } .ds-bar a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 10px; color: var(--ink, #16171A); text-decoration: none; font-weight: 550; font-size: .95rem; } .ds-bar .ds-bar__name { margin-right: auto; padding: 0; font-weight: 800; font-variation-settings: 'wdth' 112; font-size: 1.15rem; } .ds-bar a:hover, .ds-bar a[aria-current] { text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: var(--accent, #C8202B); text-decoration-thickness: 2px; text-underline-offset: .45em; }

components.css: .ds-card { width: 360px; aspect-ratio: 91/55; display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding: 20px 24px; background: var(--paper, #F4F4F1); border-radius: 3px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(22 23 26 / .12), 0 24px 48px -18px rgb(22 23 26 / .34); font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; color: var(--text, #2A2C30); } .ds-card p { margin: 0; } .ds-card__org { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: .8rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink, #16171A); } .ds-card__org span { width: 14px; height: 3px; background: var(--accent, #C8202B); } .ds-card__name { margin-top: auto !important; font-size: 1.9rem; font-weight: 800; font-variation-settings: 'wdth' 112; line-height: 1; color: var(--ink, #16171A); } .ds-card__title { margin-top: 6px !important; font-size: .78rem; } .ds-card__email { margin-top: auto !important; padding-top: 8px; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule, #C6C6C1); font-size: .8rem; }

components.name: Scale chart
components.description: Drawn to scale: hatched baseline, solid red result.
components.css: .ds-chart { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 5rem 240px; gap: 10px 12px; align-items: center; font: .9rem Archivo, sans-serif; color: var(--text, #2A2C30); } .ds-chart i { height: 18px; display: block; } .ds-chart__base { width: 100%; background: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, var(--muted, #595C62) 0 1px, transparent 1px 6px); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--muted, #595C62); } .ds-chart__result { width: 75%; background: var(--accent, #C8202B); }

narrative.overview:
The page is a technical drawing sheet, and the visitor first meets it folded into a business card. The card lies on a drafting desk with faint dimension lines that mark it as 91 by 55. When it opens, the card's stock grows into the sheet, the name walks up to the top-left title slot, and the navigation arrives. The portfolio was printed on the card all along.

The sheet is calm, precise and editorial. It is light warm grey with almost-black ink and a faint twelve-column grid ruled in hairlines. Section titles stand on full-width rules, and the footer is a drawing title block. Restraint carries the personality. One typeface, set wide and heavy for the name and plain for reading. One red, kept for the single mark that matters in each region. There is no texture, no gradient and no decoration that a draughtsman wouldn't draw.

The dark theme is the same sheet in graphite, with chalk-white ink and a brighter red.
keyCharacteristics: A drafting desk, a business card and a drawing sheet: three surfaces, one material.
A hairline grid of twelve columns across the content width, fixed to the window.
Archivo throughout, its width axis doing the work of a second face.
Red appears only for the key result, focus, and the card's rule.
Hatching marks the quieter comparison in a chart, the way a section cut does.

rules.name: The One Mark Rule
rules.body: Each region gets at most one red mark: the thing a recruiter should see first. If two things are red, neither is.

rules.name: The Token Rule
rules.body: Every colour comes from the custom properties on `:root` and `[data-theme]`. No literal colours in components.

rules.name: The Ramp Rule
rules.body: Every font size is one of the eight ramp tokens (`--fs-label` to `--fs-name`). No one-off sizes.

rules.name: The Same Lettering Rule
rules.body: The card's name and the bar's name share family, weight and width, and differ only in size. The transition depends on it.

rules.name: The Flat Sheet Rule
rules.body: Nothing on the open sheet casts a shadow. Separation comes from hairlines and space.

dos: Do keep red to one mark per region (The One Mark Rule).
Do draw separation with 1px hairlines and space, not boxes and shadows.
Do keep the card's name and the bar's name in the same lettering (The Same Lettering Rule).
Do mark a baseline or test data with hatching and keep it smaller than the result.
Do drive motion through CSS variables, so hover, focus and reduced motion keep working when the script is absent.
donts: Don't add texture, grain, gradients or glow: the sheet is clean stock.
Don't use monospace except for code.
Don't put a shadow on anything but the closed card.
Don't add tracked all-caps labels or eyebrows above headings.
Don't scale text up in a transition: move it, fade it, or scale the paper behind it.
